propositions: Two JSON-formatted derived files (index.json and criterion-pins.json) carry no banner identifying them as generated, causing plan authors to edit the artifact instead of its source and fail drift gates
The regenerate commands and their gating drift/parity gates are documented in a new table in docs/README.md, with distinct rows for hand-authored-but-gated surfaces to prevent accidental bannering
The _generated_by marker is a fixed point emitted by each generator itself, so regeneration reproduces it byte-for-byte and drift gates remain green
load_catalog() skips underscore-prefixed keys so the reserved _generated_by marker never becomes a phantom reviewer in the catalog

Two existing on-disk-equality tests (test_index_on_disk_matches_regenerated and test_user_write_does_not_change_committed_index) are re-pointed at build_index_document() to compare against the marker-bearing serialized form
A new unit test validates that the docs/README.md table exactly lists all derived surfaces and asserts each listed generated file carries its marker
